values.value: Prerequisite confirmed on the official Trailhead credential page: the Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator credential is required. The pass score is reported as 67% across third-party sources but Salesforce does not publish it on that page, so Is_Verified__c stays false until an official exam guide is located. The legacy 2018 Marketing Cloud Consultant guide quoted 68% with a Marketing Cloud Email Specialist prerequisite and is superseded.
